title: Surface environment incompatibility as linkage failure
narrative: Nubble starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Missing environment capability must become a structured pre-exec failure, not a mysterious mid-run error. Accepts inspiration requirement 16[^insp-r16].
implementation:
`DefaultLinkageResolver` environment grant check. `CliInstrumentor` verb `environment_linkage_fail`.

Acceptance walks the registered CLI verb (TestHarnessCliConfig promotes remaining story probes when no src product verb exists yet).
validation: Harness `user_story` walks the promoted product/test verb (no `probe:` wrapper); hard expects on declared observation keys.
